name: BC Children's and BC Women's Hospital Volunteer Program
org: BC Children's Hospital and BC Women's Hospital + Health Centre (Volunteer Resources)
what_you_do: Volunteers help with wayfinding, recreation and aquatic therapy, pet therapy, clinic support, special events, the Sibling Support Centre, the gift and thrift shops and the Family Library.
who_can_apply: You must be 16 or older before you apply or go to an information session. Patient contact roles need age 18 or older. Child patient support roles need work or volunteer experience with children.
duration: One year for every volunteer role
deadline_text: Apply any time. Recruitment info goes out in late October or November for a January start, in March for a May start, and in July for a September start.
how_to_apply: Submit the online application form. Volunteer Resources contacts you for an interview. If accepted, you complete a criminal record check, a reference check and orientation and training.
notes: The biggest need is Monday to Friday, 8 am to 4 pm; evening and weekend spots usually go to current volunteers. Intake can take several months. If you are not placed within 6 months, the application is closed and you may apply again. Contact: volunteer@cw.bc.ca.
